NONE: › to cause someone to become very angry

example: Plans to build a new nightclub in the neighbourhood have enraged local residents.
在附近地區新建一家夜總會的計劃激怒了當地居民。
He was enraged at the article about him.
關於他的那篇報道使他大爲光火。

NONE: › filled with great pleasure or extremely pleased by something
心花怒放的；欣喜若狂的；興高采烈的

example: The audience was enraptured by the young soloist's performance.
年輕獨奏者的表演讓觀眾聽得如癡如狂。

T: C1 [ T ] to improve the quality of something by adding something else
› [ T ] to make something or someone richer

example: Fertilizer helps to enrich the soil.
化肥可以提高土壤肥沃度。

認識了她，讓我的生活變得非常充實。

他聲稱大型商店藉由剝削顧客而獲利。
